sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five wins in their last six matches, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. This is a fixture between the division's leaders and one of the struggling sides—Alsager sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six outings, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their winning momentum.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town, on 20 points, face a challenging away trip to Dawley Town in what could be a crucial contest in the title race. AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) host Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a direct battle between top-four contenders, while Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in another fixture involving mid-table aspirants. Bilston Town (sixth) welcome Foley Meir in a meeting of sides separated by just one point. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town—both sides have struggled recently and will be seeking to arrest their form. Crewe, languishing near the bottom with just 9 points, host Allscott Heath (11th), and Brereton Social at home to Widnes Town represents a clash between two of the division's poorest performers. Shawbury United, winless in their last five, travel to Barnton, who have shown more stability with three draws in their recent form.
